metadata.title: Multiplicity of Galactic Cepheids and RR Lyrae stars from Gaia DR2 -- II. Resolved common proper motion pairs

notes: No star meets the Galactic-unbound criteria. The paper’s explicit “unbound” identification of Gaia DR2 5546476755539995008 (S1) near RS Pup refers to its not being gravitationally bound to the Cepheid (T:p11-b10), not to being unbound from the Milky Way; the same applies to other “bound/unbound” companion language.
